title: IL SORPASSO
subtitle: Italy vs the UK, GDP in US dollars

lines.say: Watch Italy and Britain in the mid-1980s.
In 1986, Italy's economy passed Britain's, in dollars. Italians called it il sorpasso: the overtaking.
Then the lira and the pound trade places. Britain ahead in 1988. Italy again in 1989.
Italy stays ahead into the 1990s. Then, in 1994, Britain moves ahead, and this time for good.
Today: the UK, 4 trillion dollars. Italy, 2.55 trillion.
The full race of Europe's biggest economies is on our channel.
